items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: And Joe Glazer had handled the Four Tops, and they didn't get paid. I did.

ctx.x: But we were there four weeks, and we were the only ones in the show that got paid. The Four Aces were on there -- not the -- the Four Tops. They were on there. They got stiffed. And there was another gal in there that was one of the -- the outfit put her in there. She was a very

nice little girl but she didn't belong in this company, you know, but I presume -- whether she got paid or not was unimportant. It was the exposure they wanted. But they didn't get paid. But this guy that had that place, I went to him. I said, "Look, are you going to pay me?" I said, "I hear rumors of how the joint's going to fold after New Years." And business, we were doing good business there, but the joint hadn't been doing good business. And he looked at me and he said, "You'll get paid." And by God, I did.…
